name: National Mineral Water SAOG
ceo: Samir Ghulam Rasoul Omar Al Balushi
hq: P.O.BOX 2740, PC 112, RUWI, SULTANATE OF OMAN.
description: National Mineral Water Company SAOG, established in 1979 and headquartered in Ruwi, Muscat, is engaged in the bottling and distribution of natural mineral water as well as trading in other beverages across the Sultanate of Oman. Through its 95%-owned subsidiary, National Distribution and Development Co. LLC (formerly Valuedeal Trading LLC), the group also trades PET preforms domestically to support beverage packaging supply chains. While parent sales revenue grew 14% YoY to OMR 4.86 million in 9M 2026 on enhanced commercial execution, intense FMCG price competition and elevated raw-material and logistics costs resulted in a OMR 798,841 net loss, with shares trading on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market.
highlights: Increased parent sales revenue 14% YoY to OMR 4.86 million in 9M 2026 (vs. OMR 4.27 million in 9M 2025) through stronger route-to-market execution and retail visibility.
Operates 95%-owned subsidiary National Distribution and Development Co. LLC specializing in domestic trading of PET bottle preforms in Oman.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 5.65M and Net Profit of -OMR 1.04M (Total Assets: OMR 5.27M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 177 registered shareholders • Omani 100.0% | GCC 0.0% | Foreign & Arab 0.0% (5 disclosed 5%+ holders).
